## Skills

- Frontend: React, Next.js, React Native (Expo), Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express, NestJS, Laravel, SSE
- Databases: PostgreSQL, PostGIS, SQL Server, Prisma, SQLite
- Desktop and delivery: Electron, NSIS auto-update, RSA licensing, Docker, Cloudflare
- Systems: Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V, PowerShell

## Selected work

- [B2B Sipariş](https://www.sbayraktar.com.tr/p/b2b-order-system): dealer portal, field-sales mobile app and ERP bridge with 1,200+ automated tests.
- [Okka ERP](https://www.sbayraktar.com.tr/p/okka): ERP covering accounting, stock, staff and production, built in TypeScript.
- [SeaWatch](https://www.sbayraktar.com.tr/p/seawatch): live vessel tracking; AIS positions filtered by region in PostGIS and streamed over SSE.
- [Neva QR](https://nevaqr.com): QR menu platform for restaurants with 42 designs, live.
- [Vega WhatsApp](https://www.sbayraktar.com.tr/p/vega-whatsapp): sends balances, statements and documents from Vega ERP over WhatsApp; running on 12 machines.
- [All 19 projects](https://www.sbayraktar.com.tr/isler)
